h: The Joy of Becoming New Through Shabbos

p: (Bamidbar 10:10) "And on the day of your rejoicing":
we find a mitzvah of rejoicing in the Torah,
but with Shabbos we do not find it.
אַךְ בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג כג, ב)
But in the holy Zohar (this parsha, III 23b):
Who gives songs in the night?'"
that a person rises at midnight
and exerts himself in the song of Torah,
is called so only at night, etc.;
HaKadosh Baruch Hu and Knesses Yisrael
to be saved from everything, etc.
rules more at night than by day,
as is written in the holy Zohar above
they were accustomed to learn with a melody,
in order to strengthen the memory,
in order to remember the teaching by heart.
"It is better to hear the rebuke of a wise man, etc.":
who raise their voices in song
"Arise, cry out in the night, etc.":
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ מִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה מְצוֹרָע פָּרָשָׁה יט)
(as Chazal said, Midrash Rabbah, Metzora, Vayikra Rabbah 19:1).
וְכֵן דָּרְשׁוּ גַּם בַּגְּמָרָא (חֲגִיגָה יב, ב)
And so they expounded in the Gemara too (Chagigah 12b):
HaKadosh Baruch Hu extends over him
a thread of Chessed by day," etc.;
"and at night His song is with me."
for which one need not look into a book,
and it is called song, as stated,
since they were accustomed to learn with melody.
And this is "Who gives songs in the night."
And by day is the time for work,
"Man goes out to his work, etc."
And at night, when a person is free
then Hashem Yisbarach extends over him
that he should be free even by day,
and his work will be done
for one who engages in Torah at night,
and the bestowal is from Chessed,
"The kindness of Keil is all day."
And it says that HaKadosh Baruch Hu
for the will of the Omnipresent
to how it was before the corruption,
and only after the corruption was he cursed:
(בְּרֵאשִׁית ג, יט) בְּזֵעַת אַפְּךָ תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם
(Bereishis 3:19) "By the sweat of your brow you shall eat bread."
And one who engages in Torah at night
merits the thread of Chessed by day,
And this is what the holy Zohar says:
"they adorn him with a thread of Chessed,
to be saved from everything," etc.
For through this he attains joy,
when a person becomes a new creation,
(מִשְׁלֵי יד, כג) בְּכָל עֶצֶב יִהְיֶה מוֹתָר
For one who goes about in tefillin
and is wholly bound to Hashem Yisbarach,
And this is "Let Yisrael rejoice in its Maker":
that Hashem Yisbarach extends over him
that he should become a new creation
as at the beginning of Creation,
and his work will be done
and he will sit all day in tefillin;
"When a person is brought to judgment,
Did you conduct your business faithfully?
Did you set times for Torah?"
only with words of Torah," etc.
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
according to what is written in the holy Zohar
עַד לָא יָהִיב קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא אוֹרַיְיתָא
before HaKadosh Baruch Hu gave the Torah,
He distinguished between those who are people of faith
וּבֵין אִינּוּן דְּלָאו בְּנֵי מְהֵימְנוּתָא וְכוּ׳
and those who are not people of faith, etc.
And with what did He distinguish them?
"And those who were not found to be people of faith,
because they were not people of faith.
'And they ground it in mills, etc.':
מָה אַטְרוּחַ לוֹן כָּל הַאי וְכוּ׳
why did they trouble themselves with all this?" etc.
For one who believed in Hashem
ate the man as it was,
puts in it the strength to sustain life,
and he did not toil to collect and gather;
while one who did not believe
and afterward "they ground it in mills."
And about this a person is asked,
"Did you conduct your business with faith?":
so that he was consequently not harried over his livelihood
וְזֶהוּ תְּחִלַּת דִּינוֹ עַל דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה
and so his judgment does begin with words of Torah.
And this is what the holy Zohar says here:
and this is called the song of Torah," etc.
Yisrael accept the yoke of His kingship:
the meal of the Field of Holy Apples;
and the resting is not yet noticeable,
since night is not a time for work.
Only, Atika Kadisha and Ze'ir Anpin
for Hashem Yisbarach testifies about Yisrael
that they will rest by day as well
when the time comes of "man goes out to his work,"
then it is the meal of Atika Kadisha,
of Avraham, the thread of Chessed.
Yet it is not yet in the open,
whether he will complete the Shabbos in rest.
And in the evening, when he has rested the whole day,
then it is the meal of Ze'ir Anpin,
that he has kept the entire Shabbos.
And this is "They shall rejoice in Your kingship,
that is, those who rest from work
and are called people of faith;
for the nations of the world do not believe
אִם כֵּן לֹא יַעֲשׂוּ מְלָאכָה בְּשַׁבָּת
"If so, let them not work on Shabbos,
and "they shall rejoice in Your kingship,"
And this is what the Sifrei says:
"And on the day of your rejoicing":
for they become a new creation.
on this day on which they rest;
and it is "the day of your rejoicing,"
as Chazal said (Taanis 15a, end of the first perek):
(Tehillim 97:11) "and for the upright of heart, joy":
for they have no fear of the yetzer hara,
since the eating is in holiness
and does not bring him to the yetzer hara;
and not a day of the body,"
as is written in the holy Zohar (Vayakhel, II 205b).
And through this they have joy
and they are called "the meal of complete faith,"
